svg.title: Humanoid spatial-memory navigation route in a saved MuJoCo maze
svg.desc: Plan view of the saved 25 by 25 Phase 2 smoke-test maze with walls, the recorded Unitree G1 navigation path, start and goal, and a moving G1 marker. This is an illustrative map animation, not footage of physical walking.
svg.text: Path traced from the successful 68-step smoke test; animation timing is illustrative.
